reports.text: CEB notice: planned power interruption in Gampaha tomorrow 09:00-15:00 for line maintenance.
Call centre: 18 customers around Veyangoda say data is very slow and calls keep dropping.
Social media post: "heard the Padukka tower is already fixed, the company van came" (unconfirmed).
NMS 06:00 | MAJOR | BER87 Beruwala | AC MAINS FAIL, running on battery bank
NMS 06:00 | MAJOR | PAD85 | rectifier input lost (mains), DC on batteries
NMS 06:00 | CRITICAL | transmission HOM12->PAD85 | fibre/MW path down, no sync

finding.finding: The cited authoritative snapshots establish grid power loss at Beruwala (S01) and Padukka (S09), and a down backhaul link from Homagama (S08) to Padukka (S09). No equipment status is stated.

Resolved faults show S01 and S09 lack grid power, S02 grid-power status is unresolved, and link L09 is down. The catalogue contains generator-deployment actions for the power faults and a link-repair action for L09. Crews C1 and C2 have generator and equipment skills, but neither has the backhaul skill required for link repair. No crew has a listed backhaul skill. Roads to the relevant sites are available; no unsafe or impossible condition is evidenced. Generator G1 is available at DEPOT, but its runtime and capacity details are not sufficient to establish whether it can support the affected S

questions.question: Can you assign a backhaul-skilled crew to repair L09, and when will one be available?
Can G1 support the needed temporary power deployments at S01 and S09, including runtime/capacity and whether it can serve more than one site?
Please confirm the current grid-power status at S02; the resolved state marks it unknown while verified observations report grid power down.

finding.finding: Using the approved weights unchanged, S09 Padukka (critical, weight 5) is the highest-priority outage: its mains have failed and the HOM12→PAD85 transmission path is down, leaving its service unavailable. S01 Beruwala (standard, weight 1) also has an authoritative mains-failure report and is running on batteries. S02 has unknown grid-power status, so its outage status is not established. The reported Veyangoda complaints do not establish an asset condition; the Padukka repair rumor is unconfirmed, and the Gampaha notice describes a future interruption, not a current outage.
